category.name: Productivity and workspace
category.description: Email, calendars, files, notes, tasks and project management.

entries.name: Airtable API
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access on Free plan, ~5 req/sec per base
entries.desc_en: Read and write records in Airtable bases and tables via REST API.
entries.notes: Official JS client available; Python/Ruby/.NET clients are community-maintained.

entries.name: Asana API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: API included on Personal (free) plan, rate limited
entries.desc_en: Create tasks, projects, and comments in Asana workspaces via REST API.
entries.notes: No official MCP server confirmed as of this check.

entries.name: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence)
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 token> (or basic auth with API token for Cloud REST)
entries.free_tier: free tier: available on Free Jira/Confluence plans; rate limits vary by plan
entries.desc_en: Create and manage Jira issues and Confluence pages via REST API or the official remote MCP server.
entries.notes: Official Atlassian Remote MCP (Rovo) rate limits range 500-10,000+ calls/hour depending on subscription tier; does not store/cache content.

entries.name: Box API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (Box API generally requires a paid Box account for meaningful use)
entries.desc_en: Upload, download, and manage files, folders, and metadata in Box via REST API.
entries.notes: Also supports JWT/Client Credentials Grant for server-to-server auth.

entries.name: Cal.com API
entries.free_tier: free tier: API included on Free plan, 120 req/min (higher limits on request)
entries.desc_en: Create and manage bookings, event types, and availability via the Cal.com REST API v2.
entries.notes: OAuth strongly recommended for production integrations; API keys are simpler but less secure.

entries.name: Calendly API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: check pricing (personal access tokens available for own-account use; broader API access varies by plan)
entries.desc_en: Programmatically book meetings and read/write scheduling, event, and contact data via REST API v2.

entries.name: ClickUp API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: <personal API token> (no Bearer prefix) or OAuth2 token
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Free Forever plan
entries.desc_en: Create and manage ClickUp tasks, lists, and docs via REST API or the official MCP server.

entries.name: Coda API (Superhuman Docs)
entries.free_tier: free, included for all users on both free and paid workspaces
entries.desc_en: Read and write Coda (now 'Superhuman Docs') documents, tables, and rows via REST API or an MCP server.
entries.notes: Coda was rebranded to 'Superhuman Docs' after Grammarly's acquisition; the API base URL (coda.io/apis/v1) still works. Docs mention an official MCP server optimized for LLM usage, but the exact remote endpoint wasn't independently confirmed this session.

entries.name: Dropbox API
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Basic (free) plan, rate limited
entries.desc_en: Upload, download, and manage files and folders in Dropbox via the HTTP REST API.

entries.name: Google Workspace APIs (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
entries.desc_en: Read/write Gmail messages, Calendar events, and Drive files programmatically via REST APIs.
entries.notes: Each Workspace API (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) has its own quota; sensitive/restricted scopes require OAuth consent screen verification.

entries.name: Linear API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API key or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: API access included on Free plan (rate limited)
entries.desc_en: Create, query, and update Linear issues, projects, and comments via GraphQL API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: GraphQL API (not REST). Official MCP also has a read-only variant at mcp.linear.app/mcp/readonly.

entries.name: Microsoft Graph (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive)
entries.free_tier: free with a Microsoft 365/Entra ID tenant (free dev tenant via Microsoft 365 Developer Program)
entries.desc_en: Single REST endpoint to read/write Outlook mail, Calendar events, Teams, and OneDrive/SharePoint data.
entries.notes: Requires app registration in Microsoft Entra ID; delegated vs application permissions determine required consent.

entries.name: monday.com API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: <personal API token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free tier: GraphQL API included on Free plan (rate limited)
entries.desc_en: Query and update monday.com boards, items, and workflows via GraphQL API or a hosted MCP endpoint.
entries.notes: monday.com docs confirm a native/hosted MCP connection option for AI assistants, but the exact current endpoint URL could not be independently confirmed this session — check developer.monday.com.

entries.name: Notion API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <integration token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free, API access included on all plans (rate limit ~3 req/sec)
entries.desc_en: Read, create, and update Notion pages, databases, and comments via REST API.
entries.notes: Internal integrations use static tokens; public integrations use OAuth2. Official hosted MCP endpoint requires sign-in (returns 401 unauthenticated).

entries.name: Todoist API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API token or OAuth2 token>
entries.free_tier: free to use; some features gated by the user's Todoist plan
entries.desc_en: Create, read, and complete Todoist tasks and projects via REST API or the official MCP server.
entries.notes: Official MCP works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code; supports OAuth dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).

entries.name: Trello API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (or legacy key+token query params)
entries.free_tier: free, no key needed to register an app; usage is rate limited
entries.desc_en: Create and manage Trello boards, lists, and cards via REST API.
entries.notes: Now documented under the Atlassian developer platform; supports both legacy key+token and OAuth2 bearer auth.
